messages:
Lina Park: Quick thread: we need a canonical 'anchor set' approach for mixed-precision rollouts. Current ad-hoc prompts are causing noisy signal.
Omar Reyes: Agree. Are we talking short diagnostic prompts or full-conversation anchors?
Lina Park: both. small deterministic anchors for regression (+seeded rng), and a few longform dialogs to catch downstream effects.
Benji Cox: We should also freeze tokenizer boundaries in anchors. tokenization diffs ruin diffs when quant changes tiny outputs.
Lina Park: yes: anchor artifact includes: prompt text, tokenizer_version, seed, expected logits hash, golden response snapshots.
Omar Reyes: Expected logits hash? explain.
Lina Park: run a canonical forward pass with high-precision baseline, hash top-k logits per token to detect subtle drift before string diffs. faster and less noisy.
Benji Cox: nice. hashes let us detect when quant changed probability mass even if text same. good signal for perf-quality tradeoffs.
Omar Reyes: How big is the anchor set? We don't want to slow CI.
Lina Park: two tiers: smoke anchors (20 very targeted prompts) for PR/CI, and extended anchors (200 prompts) for staging/canary.
Benji Cox: sampling strategy: run smoke anchors on every PR that touches quant code; extended anchors run nightly on staging artifacts.
Omar Reyes: storage/format? compressed artifact with jsonl entries. each entry: {id, prompt, tok_ver, seed, topk_hash, snapshot_id}. Keep metadata small.
Lina Park: sketch example:
```
# anchor entry (sketch)
- id: anchor_attn_proj_01
  prompt: "Summarize: ..."
  tokenizer: tkn-v3
  seed: 42
  topk_hash: b2f9d8...
  snapshot: s3://anchors/2026-03-01/anchor_attn_proj_01.snap
```
Benji Cox: Eval rules: if topk_hash mismatch on smoke anchors -> block PR. If mismatch on extended anchors -> gate canary with human review.
Omar Reyes: Need thresholds. some drift is tolerable. Topk-hash is binary; maybe use KL on topk distribution and a threshold too.
Lina Park: good: smoke rules: brute mismatch OR KL>0.02 -> fail. staging: KL>0.01 triggers alert and human review.
Benji Cox: tie this into quant profile lint: if profile changes operator-fallbacks for an op in anchor list, auto-run its anchors locally.
Omar Reyes: runtime note: anchor snapshots must be stable across model variants (same tokenizer and model version). record model_git_sha in artifact.
Lina Park: anchor provenance: anchor_id -> owning-team -> last-updated -> approved-signers. ops will require two approvers for any anchor that exercises safety-critical ops.
Benji Cox: telemetry: during canary shadowing, emit per-anchor drift counters and a small sample of token-level logits for anchors that drift to help debugging. sampling for anchors only.
Omar Reyes: CI perf cost: we should cache baseline topk_hash per model commit and only recompute when model weights change.
Lina Park: yes store baseline hashes keyed by model_commit and tokenizer. CI compares artifact output against that.
Benji Cox: action items: 1) Lina: draft anchor schema + lint rules. 2) Omar: add topk-hash lib and KL comparator to eval harness. 3) Benji: hook anchor checks into quant profile lint.
ops-bot: Created ML-4500: "Anchor set + hash-based regression checks" assigned to Lina Park, Omar Reyes, Benji Cox. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-4500 :white_check_mark:
Lina Park: timeline: schema + PR today, smoke anchors in CI next week. thanks.
Benji Cox: will add tests for tokenizer-stable snapshots.
Omar Reyes: I'll prototype topk-hash util today.
Lina Park: great, we'll reconvene after prototypes. :rocket:
